description: Return the top ten plus every row tied with the tenth.

a.request: For each transaction in `sentimentandfundamentals` (`transref`), take the average analyst coverage count (`anlycount`, ignoring missing values). Keep only the transactions whose average is above the overall average of those per-transaction averages. For each one, show `transref`, its average, how far it is above that overall average, and how far it is above the average among just the kept transactions. Sort by that last difference, highest first (missing last), and return the top 10 rows plus every other row tied with the 10th. Don't round.
a.sql: WITH transaction_averages AS (SELECT transref, AVG(anlycount) AS avg_anlycount FROM sentimentandfundamentals GROUP BY transref), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_anlycount) AS overall_avg FROM transaction_averages), kept AS (SELECT ta.transref, ta.avg_anlycount, o.overall_avg FROM transaction_averages ta CROSS JOIN overall o WHERE ta.avg_anlycount > o.overall_avg), kept_average AS (SELECT AVG(avg_anlycount) AS kept_avg FROM kept) SELECT k.transref, k.avg_anlycount, k.avg_anlycount - k.overall_avg AS above_overall_avg, k.avg_anlycount - ka.kept_avg AS above_kept_avg FROM kept k CROSS JOIN kept_average ka ORDER BY above_kept_avg DESC NULLS LAST FETCH FIRST 10 ROWS WITH TIES

c.request: For each transaction in `sentimentandfundamentals` (`transref`), take the average analyst coverage count (`anlycount`, ignoring missing values). Keep only the transactions whose average is above the overall average of those per-transaction averages. For each one, show `transref`, its average, how far it is above that overall average, and how far it is above the average among just the kept transactions. Give me the top 10 by that last difference, highest first (missing last). Don't round. Return the top ten plus every row tied with the tenth.
c.sql: WITH transaction_averages AS (SELECT transref, AVG(anlycount) AS avg_analyst_count FROM sentimentandfundamentals GROUP BY transref), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_analyst_count) AS overall_avg FROM transaction_averages), kept AS (SELECT t.transref, t.avg_analyst_count, o.overall_avg FROM transaction_averages t CROSS JOIN overall o WHERE t.avg_analyst_count > o.overall_avg), kept_average AS (SELECT AVG(avg_analyst_count) AS kept_avg FROM kept) SELECT k.transref, k.avg_analyst_count, k.avg_analyst_count - k.overall_avg AS above_overall_avg, k.avg_analyst_count - a.kept_avg AS above_kept_avg FROM kept k CROSS JOIN kept_average a ORDER BY above_kept_avg DESC NULLS LAST FETCH FIRST 10 ROWS WITH TIES

b.request: For each `transref`, average its non-null `anlycount` values; retain transactions whose average exceeds the unweighted average of all non-null per-transaction averages; return `transref`, its average, its difference from that overall average, and its difference from the average of the retained transactions, ordered by the last difference descending with nulls last, including the top 10 and every row tied with tenth, without rounding
b.sql: WITH per_transaction AS (SELECT transref, AVG(anlycount) AS avg_anlycount FROM sentimentandfundamentals GROUP BY transref), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_anlycount) AS overall_avg FROM per_transaction), retained AS (SELECT p.transref, p.avg_anlycount, o.overall_avg FROM per_transaction p CROSS JOIN overall o WHERE p.avg_anlycount > o.overall_avg), retained_average AS (SELECT AVG(avg_anlycount) AS retained_avg FROM retained) SELECT r.transref, r.avg_anlycount, r.avg_anlycount - r.overall_avg AS difference_from_overall, r.avg_anlycount - a.retained_avg AS difference_from_retained FROM retained r CROSS JOIN retained_average a ORDER BY difference_from_retained DESC NULLS LAST FETCH FIRST 10 ROWS WITH TIES

d.request: For each `transref` in `sentimentandfundamentals`, calculate the average `anlycount`, ignoring missing values. Keep transactions whose average exceeds the overall average of the per-transaction averages. For each kept transaction, show `transref`, its average, its difference from the overall average, and its difference from the average among kept transactions. Sort by the last difference, highest first with missing values last, and return the top 10 plus every row tied with the tenth. Do not round.
d.sql: WITH per_transaction AS (SELECT transref, AVG(anlycount) AS avg_anlycount FROM sentimentandfundamentals GROUP BY transref), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_anlycount) AS overall_avg FROM per_transaction), kept AS (SELECT p.transref, p.avg_anlycount, p.avg_anlycount - o.overall_avg AS difference_from_overall FROM per_transaction p CROSS JOIN overall o WHERE p.avg_anlycount > o.overall_avg), scored AS (SELECT transref, avg_anlycount, difference_from_overall, avg_anlycount - AVG(avg_anlycount) OVER () AS difference_from_kept_average FROM kept) SELECT transref, avg_anlycount, difference_from_overall, difference_from_kept_average FROM scored ORDER BY difference_from_kept_average DESC NULLS LAST FETCH FIRST 10 ROWS WITH TIES
